verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm. Its documented legaltech offerings are questionnaire-driven document generators (SCC and Term Sheet tools built on Contract Express), a Docusign execution integration, and AI review tools; none of these is a user-configurable rules engine that fires actions on events. Event-triggered automation rules are a category error for a legal-services provider, and the evidence does not show the firm shipping such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
